decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system extends the firm's established office business, carries little extra cost, and its value is still unresolved as hybrid-work demand evolves, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
A chair family close to the core range is cheap to keep in a premium line where products have long lifecycles, and nothing suggests it has failed.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain demand, but they reuse existing carpet materials at low carrying cost, so keeping them is still justified, though they are the most likely to be pruned.
The designer sofa from EOOS was actively promoted in 2019 and sits in the firm's core upholstery competence, so it remains a valuable product with low carrying cost.
The high standing table fits the conference and lounge range at low incremental cost, and its prospects in flexible workplace settings are still developing.
The rug collection is presented as a flagship of the firm's strategic direction, and its value as an entry into a new category is still unfolding, so management keeps investing in it.
